entities.summary: Betty Nana Efua Krosbi Mensah, is a Ghanaian politician and a former Member of Parliament for the 7th and 8th parliament of the republic of Ghana for the Afram Plains North constituency in the Eastern region of Ghana. She is a member of the National Democratic Congress.
